profile.headline: Software Engineer at Datalogic
profile.summary: More than ten years of multi-threaded Java application development experience with five years of C/C++ experience in Windows and Linux platforms.  Specialized on JIDE Chart, and YFiles Graph.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Implemented new features and maintained the front end of Xilinx Vivado software in Java,   a   software  suite for  synthesis   and   analysis   of   HDL   designs,   superseding   Xilinx   ISE,   ChipScope   Analyzer 
 and   Impacts. 
● Implemented   Tcl   Find   to   allow   users   easily   search   hardware   design   netlist. 
● Developed   Vivado   Labtools   to   ease   users   on   runme   debugging   their   hardware 
 design. 
● Parcipated   in   Vivado   new   Look   and   Feel   to   provide   a   modern   simpliﬁed   GUI   look. 
● Designed   a   Vivado   Labtools   GUI   regression   suite   to   improve   code   test   coverage.
● Implemented   new   features   and   maintained   Xilinx   ChipScope   Analyzer   soware,   a 
 debugging   soware   for   the   hardware   engineer   to   view   the   hardware   design   on   any 
 internal   signal   or   node,   including   embedding   hard   or   so   processors.  
● Implemented   GUI   and   backend   of   ChipScope   Pro   Serial   I/O   Toolkit   which   provides   the 
 capability   to   measure   bit-error   raos   on   mulple   RocketIO   channels   and   adjust 
 high-speed   serial   transceiver   parameters   in   real-me   while   serial   I/O   channels   are 
 interacng   with   the   rest   of   the   system.

positions.title: Java Swing Developer
positions.description: ● Implemented new features and ﬁxed defects for Symantec Security Services.

positions.title: Java Swing Developer
positions.description:
● Developed new features for Sun Bugtraq 2.0, a bug tracking system for over 10,000 Sun Microsystems internal users, using Siebel schema to connect to Oracle database. This system is a four tier enterprise application; using Oracle database as the backend, Siebel and iPlanet as the middle tier, a stand-alone heavy Java client application as the front end. 
● Participated in designing Sun Bugster OEM, a micro version of Sun Bugtraq 2.0. This is a web application for Sun Partner users.

volunteerExperiences.description: Manage Girl Scouts Service Unit 620 Fall Sale activities (Nuts/Candies/Magazines Sale), including training 4-10 troops Fall Sale Managers, Booth Sale Manager, and Cupboard Manager, scheduling booth sales, supervising troops Fall Sale and organizing sale reports.
Participated annual camping competition event, set up campground, training girls of survival skills, judge the competitions.
